shortBio.en: Black Sabbath’s original vocalist; solo career after 1979 firing, with later Sabbath reunions.
shortBio.zh: Black Sabbath 原主唱；1979 被撤后展开独唱生涯，并有后期 Sabbath 重聚。

whyHub.en: Textbook band → solo flow: removed from founding metal lineup, then larger as a solo brand.
whyHub.zh: 教科书式乐队 → 独唱流动：离开创始金属阵容后，独唱品牌体量更大。

body.en:
Born 1948, Birmingham. Ozzy-era Sabbath (1970–78 peak records) is one object; Dio-era Sabbath is another; Blizzard of Ozz–era solo with Randy Rhoads is a third graph.

Person pages exist so lineup versions stay comparable. Nasal lead and stage persona are constants; songwriting partners change.
body.zh:
1948 年生于伯明翰。Ozzy 时期 Sabbath（1970–78 峰值唱片）是一对象；Dio 时期 Sabbath 是另一对象；与 Randy Rhoads 的 Blizzard of Ozz 独唱是第三图谱。

人物页存在是为了让阵容版本可比较。鼻音主唱与舞台人设是常量；写作搭档更换。

note.zh: 创始 Ozzy 时期金属巅峰。
